plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='17' y='15' width='4' height='15' rx='1' fill='black'/><rect x='29' y='15' width='4' height='15' rx='1' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.history: Patented by Harvey Hubbell in 1904, it was the first design intended to separate appliances from light sockets.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><g transform='rotate(180 25 25)'><rect x='17' y='23' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='black'/><rect x='29' y='23' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='black'/><circle cx='25' cy='15' r='3.5' fill='black'/></g></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Two flat blades with a round grounding pin.
plug_types.history: Developed in the 1920s as grounding became a safety requirement for electrical equipment.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='15' y='15' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='29' y='15' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.history: Standardized as the 'Europlug' (EN 50075) for small appliances across Europe.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='15' y='24' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='29' y='24' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='22' y='12' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Three large round pins in a triangle.
plug_types.history: Originally the British standard (BS 546) before Type G took over in the UK.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='15' y='24' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='29' y='24' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='22' y='12' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='1'/></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Two round pins and a hole for grounding.
plug_types.history: French standard designed for correct polarity via a socket-mounted pin.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='15' y='22' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='29' y='22' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='22' y='8' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='black'/><rect x='22' y='40' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Two round pins with side grounding clips.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='23' y='10' width='4' height='10' rx='1' fill='black'/><rect x='12' y='30' width='10' height='4' rx='1' fill='black'/><rect x='28' y='30' width='10' height='4' rx='1' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.history: British standard (BS 1363) introduced for post-war ring circuits.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><g transform='rotate(30 15 18)'><rect x='12' y='15' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='14' y='14' width='2' height='8' fill='black'></rect></g><g transform='rotate(-30 35 18)'><rect x='32' y='15' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='34' y='14' width='2' height='8' fill='black'></rect></g><g><rect x='22' y='30' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='24' y='29' width='2' height='8' fill='black'></rect></g></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Three round notched pins in Y-shape.
plug_types.history: Exclusive to Israel; updated in 1989 to accommodate round pins.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='13' y='14' width='2' height='10' rx='1' fill='black' transform='rotate(30 14 19)'/><rect x='35' y='14' width='2' height='10' rx='1' fill='black' transform='rotate(-30 36 19)'/><rect x='24' y='30' width='2' height='10' rx='1' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Two slanted flat blades and one vertical ground.
plug_types.history: Developed in Australia, adopted by China and Argentina.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='10' y='22' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='34' y='22' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='22' y='27' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Three round pins in a flat triangle.
plug_types.history: Swiss standard designed for high socket density.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='15' y='18' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='29' y='18' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><path d='M21 32 h8 v2 a4 4 0 0 1 -8 0 z' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Two round pins and a U-shaped ground.
plug_types.history: Danish 'smiley' standard, uniquely shaped grounding pin.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='11' y='22' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='22' y='22' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='33' y='22' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Three round pins in a straight line.
plug_types.history: Italian standard; exists in two amperage-specific sizes.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='11' y='26' width='8' height='8' rx='4' fill='black'/><rect x='31' y='26' width='8' height='8' rx='4' fill='black'/><rect x='21' y='10' width='8' height='8' rx='4' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.history: 15-amp heavy duty standard used in India and South Africa.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='12' y='21' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='32' y='21' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='22' y='24' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Three round pins in a flat triangle.
plug_types.history: The IEC international standard adopted by Brazil and South Africa.

plug_types.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 50 50'><rect x='13' y='15' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='31' y='15' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/><rect x='22' y='30' width='6' height='6' rx='3' fill='black'/></svg>
plug_types.physical_description: Three round pins in a sharp triangle.
plug_types.history: Introduced in Thailand in 2006 to simplify hybrid systems.
